description: Product-facing project record consumed by gridlock-challenge. Produced by gridlock-data-pipeline. Do not invent missing values.
notes: geometry uses GeoJSON axis order: longitude, latitude.
A Point may be stored as [lng, lat] with geometry_type Point.
A LineString may be stored as [[lng, lat], ...] with geometry_type LineString.
If geometry is null, the project is counted but not geographically compared.
If timing fields are null, timeline overlap is treated as unknown (not true).
data/projects.json is demo/legacy only and must not be labeled verified.
